newsitem.title: UK: UK Sept bank mortgage lending up 417 mln stg - BBA.
newsitem.headline: UK Sept bank mortgage lending up 417 mln stg - BBA.

text.p: The British Bankers' Association released the following data for net lending for house purchase by financial institutions in September.
(in millions of stg unless otherwise stated)
The BBA said the rise in the major banks' net lending in September was well below the recent monthly average.
"In the context of the housing market recovery this was unexpected, but it would be a mistake to read too much into a single month's figures," said Tim Sweeney, director general of the BBA.
"Looked at overall, recent mortgage industry data suggest that firmer conditions in the housing market will continue in the months ahead."
